name: jroedel/laminas-juser
description: Passwordless (magic-link) user module. A Laminas MVC module in 2.x; Symfony-oriented in 3.x.

suggest.kokspflanze/bjy-authorize: Only for JUser\Bridge\Laminas: its identity provider, role providers and role entity. A host implementing Host\AccessInterface over anything else needs none of it.
suggest.laminas/laminas-authentication: Only for JUser\Bridge\Laminas: the SessionUser storage and the authentication-service factory behind zfcuser_auth_service. Host\IdentityInterface is the replacement.
suggest.laminas/laminas-eventmanager: Only for JUser\Bridge\Laminas\RedirectionStrategy, which is a laminas-mvc listener aggregate.
suggest.laminas/laminas-http: Only for JUser\Bridge\Laminas\RedirectionStrategy, which sets a Laminas\Http\Response status.
suggest.laminas/laminas-mvc: Only for JUser\Bridge\Laminas: MvcEvent, reached by RedirectionStrategy. Nothing else in this module registers with laminas-mvc.
suggest.laminas/laminas-permissions-acl: Only for JUser\Bridge\Laminas, transitively with bjy-authorize.
suggest.laminas/laminas-session: Only for JUser\Bridge\Laminas: the session storage behind the laminas auth service. Host\SessionInterface is the replacement.
suggest.laminas/laminas-view: Only for JUser\Bridge\Laminas: the two .phtml view helpers a bridged layout calls. Twig hosts render through JUser\Twig\JUserExtension instead.
